scope: Numerical evidence for the current manuscript: retained R1/R2 evidence plus local R3 sensitivity, heldout selection, joint uncertainty and Python metadata measurements. Not all historical project experiments. External NPZ arrays are hash-indexed, not embedded.

replication.measurement: 12 separately launched processes on one host

dynamic_families.rotating_hotspots: 8 hot IDs switch cyclically among four disjoint sets every 256 messages; 20% unique scans
dynamic_families.bursty_migration: same mixed construction, switch every512; within each128 messages,32 gaps scaled0.1 and96 scaled1.3; expected gap scale=1

config.empirical_service: Independently sample pooled q/table/build operation timings with replacement; share the three per-event arrays across methods; no assertion that q and table were measured as paired calls. Arrivals remain tied to mean q.
config.ci_scope: Conditional on measured mean costs or the empirical timing pool. Process-level calibration CIs reported separately.
config.metadata: Optional table capacities equal; metadata excluded and separately counted; not byte-matched cache comparison.
config.boundary: Exact H*delta - NB*B - N*p for cost-independent admission decisions; empirical policy envelope, not an optimal online policy.

measurement_summary.json.replication_unit: independent software process on one host
measurement_summary.json.policy_measurement: Complete reference policy loop minus Q-only no-op traversal; equal mean across six workload families; isolated operation timings are not summed.

round2/round2_config.json.purpose: Check second simulated review; primary estimands and original measured input records retained
round2/round2_config.json.overhead_replication: 12 process means within each workload; seed811611
round2/round2_config.json.joint_cycle: Sample one (process,cycle) per message; q/table/build from the same serial measurement round
round2/round2_config.json.process_block128: Hold process for128messages; within each64-message segment sample a cyclic consecutive set of64 retained cycles, with independent starting offsets
round2/round2_config.json.dependence_scope: Timing-based stress models, not measured live CPU-state trajectories or simultaneous counterfactual verifications
round2/round2_config.json.policy_overhead: Workload-specific p reruns full original primary matrix; dependent-service study retains equal-family mean p to isolate service dependence

round3/metadata_memory_environment.json.definition: tracemalloc incremental allocations after input IDs exist, including Policy containers, retained metadata and transient Python work; no native acceleration-table allocation or complete process RSS
round3/metadata_memory_environment.json.peak: Observed at every policy step; tracemalloc peak is allocator-tracked peak, not a sum of object sizes
round3/metadata_memory_environment.json.implementation_note: The retained Immediate reference also fills the shared threshold-counter dictionary. This is an implementation cost, not a necessary property of immediate admission.

round3/round3_config.json.scope: Single-host calibration-driven single-server FCFS sensitivity; no cluster experiment

arrival_modes.fixed_lambda: Original absolute arrivals held fixed at q_mean/0.95; sampled q changes realized load
arrival_modes.fixed_rho: Arrivals rescaled with sampled q/0.95 to hold reference load fixed

round3/round3_config.json.process_resampling: Sample whole process parameter vectors jointly, preserving q/table/build/p associations; then independently sample trace seed blocks

provenance.json.scope: Independent software processes on one host, not independent machines; policy and crypto timings obtained in same WSL environment; no physical vehicle tests.

boundary_definition.objective: argmin over methods of N*q + mean(N_B)*B - mean(N_H)*delta + N*p_method
boundary_definition.mean_over: 30 seed traces, separately by workload and K
boundary_definition.interpretation: mean service cost only, not completion optimality or selection confidence

fig5_scope.heatmap_uncertainty: Cell means; conditional 95% intervals for every cell are in hotset_scan_summary.csv. Markers are descriptive, not equivalence tests.

supp_deadlines.bands: Conditional percentile 95% bootstrap intervals, 10000 resamples; policies share seeds and arrivals. 500 ms retained in source data.

supp_nearties.normalization: 100 * (W_runnerup - W_best) / (N*q); six policies, mean counts over 30 traces
supp_nearties.uncertainty: Deterministic mean-cost surfaces; tolerance is not a statistical equivalence margin.

data_roles.JSON: All current table/plot aggregates and run-level CSV records plus 12 calibration records. Enough to redraw numerical manuscript plots.
